spec.name: Opal Globe Wire Table Lamp
spec.silhouette: Spherical globe within a minimalist cylindrical wire frame
spec.proportions: Compact, approximately 25 cm diameter by 28 cm height

parts.shape: Horizontal circular ring with vertical slim rod legs

details: Slender metal wire ring girdling the globe's lower hemisphere
Evenly spaced vertical wire legs extending to table surface
Soft internal illumination diffusing through frosted glass
spec.studio_prompt: A modern table lamp measuring 25 cm in diameter and 28 cm in height. The fixture features a spherical diffuser made of smooth frosted opal glass (#ccb894) emitting a warm internal glow (#957349). The globe is cradled within a geometric frame constructed from thin steel wire in a matte black finish (#4b2a12), consisting of an equatorial circular ring resting on vertical wire legs and a low-profile central base disc (#774f2c).
